value.rationale: The circular-ladder PMC is a naturally motivated infinite topological family whose nonequivariant homotopy changes with size. Primitive simultaneous rotation and layer exchange exhibit a sharp parity change in the actual fixed space (one versus three isolated points), which detects nonzero equivariant Lefschetz information invisible to Betti counts and the unscrewed layer involution. It is a structural classification of the complete primitive-action fixed locus, not a one-off parameter or normalization calculation.
